label: Ubiquiti UniFi 5G Max Modem
description: 5G NR/LTE modem for UniFi: one 2.5GbE RJ45, PoE input, nano-SIM or eSIM.
notes: Vendor figures from the Ubiquiti tech specs page: Networking Interface **(1) 2.5 GbE RJ45 port**, **5G NR and LTE** radio, nano-SIM or eSIM, PoE input, IK04 tamper resistance, 410 g. The 2.5G port is the point: it will not bottleneck a 5G NR link the way a gigabit port would, which is exactly the difference from the plain U5G.
